prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1024x768 landscape (4:3), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = furniture/walls, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look.
Interior room seen from above, cut-away walls on the top edge only, floor fills most of the image. The cosy cabin of an old harbour captain's houseboat: worn wooden plank floor (large walkable area), low ceiling beams cut away, round brass portholes in the top wall showing a dark harbour with neon reflections.
TOP LEFT: a built-in wooden bunk bed with a patchwork quilt and a knitted pillow, a small reading lamp.
TOP CENTER: a big old wooden ship's steering wheel in front of the porthole windows - the most eye-catching spot, with a brass compass and a dusty ship's bell.
TOP RIGHT: a bookshelf with old leather logbooks, rolled sea charts and a model ship.
RIGHT WALL: a tall shelf full of message-in-a-bottle bottles of all colours and sizes, some with rolled paper inside, glowing softly.
CENTER: a sturdy round table bolted to the floor with a checked cloth, two mugs, a candle in a bottle, an oil lamp, three stools.
BOTTOM LEFT: a tiny galley kitchen corner with a small stove, a kettle, hanging pans and a basket of driftwood.
Details: fishing nets and a life ring on the walls, a brass foghorn hanging on a hook, a rug, warm yellow lamp light mixed with cyan neon from outside, cables drawn thin.
EXIT clearly readable: BOTTOM CENTER - the cabin door with a little step leading out to the gangway.
Time: night.
